description: Shared conformance cases for the byobot v0 contract. Every implementation must accept each case with valid=true and reject each case with valid=false, validating `data` against schema/v0/<schema>.schema.json. Cases with a `rule` are rejected by a semantic rule JSON Schema cannot express (see schema/README.md).

cases.description: An activity with tags and the metrics to ask for when logging it.
